commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
90+7' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+6' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
90+3' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+3' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Tottenham can continue in their attacking effort.
90+1' Aston Villa take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+1' The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick. Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' John McGinn (Aston Villa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simon Hooper no option but to blow his whistle.
87' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by John McGinn (Aston Villa).
87' John McGinn (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.
86' It's time for a substitution. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) comes on in place of Djed Spence.
86' Here comes a substitution. Rodrigo Bentancur is given a rest as he is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
85' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
82' Here is a change. Amadou Onana is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).

81' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Wilson Odobert is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham).
79' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) replaces Xavi Simons.
77' 1 - 2 Goal! Lucas Digne plays a short, square pass into the path of Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 1:2. Fabulous goal!
77' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

77' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
73' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) but poses no threat.
72' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
71' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
69' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
67' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Kevin Danso (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
67' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
66' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) makes a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
65' The ball possession is 57:43.
63' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa).
61' The referee allows time for a substitution. Donyell Malen will be replaced by Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa).
61' Unai Emery has decided to substitute Evann Guessand and he is replaced by Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).
60' Thomas Frank is forced to make a change. Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is unable to continue due to injury, Richarlison comes on.
59' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
58' Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires well wide of the left post.
57' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
55' Tottenham are ruled offside.
55' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

55' Tottenham win a corner. That was a nice football moment. Joao Palhinha (Tottenham) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Emiliano Martinez guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

53' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
52' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
49' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Rough tackle by Xavi Simons (Tottenham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham.
45+5' Djed Spence (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
45+4' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+4' The ball is cleared after Djed Spence (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45+2' An accurate cross picks out Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
45+1' Simon Hooper has a clear sight and sees a foul from John McGinn (Aston Villa).
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
42' Dangerous play by Mathys Tel (Tottenham). Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the roof of the net.
35' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) serves up a nice cross, but Guglielmo Vicario punches the ball away.
34' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
32' The game is interrupted now, Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
32' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
27' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Emiliano Martinez.
25' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
25' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Tottenham force their opponents to concede a corner.
23' Evann Guessand (Aston Villa) commits a rough foul. Simon Hooper stops the game and makes a call.
23' Wilson Odobert (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
22' A corner kick by Tottenham is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
21' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
18' The game is interrupted. Xavi Simons (Tottenham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
18' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
17' Donyell Malen (Aston Villa) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
15' High and wide! Matty Cash (Aston Villa) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
14' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
12' None of the Aston Villa players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

12' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.
12' John McGinn (Aston Villa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
9' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Matty Cash (Aston Villa).
7' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Joao Palhinha gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 1:0.
5' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
5' The ball is cleared after Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner.
4' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
3' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
